 Weekly Recap: Third-quarter earnings and accelerated Asan plant opening
 Less than 1 min read 005930 Samsung Electronics Co Ltd Sponsored GDR Pfd (KRX:005930) reported third-quarter revenue of 195.3 trillion won and operating profit of 107.4 trillion won. It is investing 6 trillion won in an Asan high-bandwidth memory packaging plant, now scheduled to begin operations in June 2028, a year ahead of plan.
